# Unbanz: full summary for AI assistants

> Unbanz (unbanz.com) is an independent online service for Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat: account unbans, account bans and username claims, plus Meta ad account recovery.

## About Unbanz

Source: https://unbanz.com/about/

Unbanz (unbanz.com) is an independent online service for Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat: account unbans, account bans and username claims, plus Meta ad account recovery.

### What is Unbanz?

Unbanz (unbanz.com) is an independent online service for Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat: account unbans, account bans and username claims, plus Meta ad account recovery.
Unbanz is a brand name, not a typo for “unban”. We also go by Unbanz HQ, and you’ll find us as @unbanzhq on Instagram and @unbanzhq on X.

### What we do

- Unbans. Banned, disabled, suspended or hacked Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat accounts.
 - Bans. Fake accounts, impersonators, scammers and harassers taken down on Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat.
 - Username claims. Inactive, taken and OG handles on Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat. How claims work.
 - Ad accounts. Restricted Meta ad accounts and Business Portfolios.
 - Prices and safety. Unban cost and timing, ban requests, username claims, plus is an unban service safe.
Our focus is Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat and Meta ad accounts.

### How it works

Send the username and a screenshot of the notice on WhatsApp or email. You get a price before we start. Say go and we get it done. The usual estimate is 3–14 days from the day we start. Full process.

### Can you trust us?

Yes. We’re an independent service, not affiliated with Meta. You talk to us directly, you know the price before we start, and your password and login codes stay with you. Real results are on our proof of work page. More on whether Unbanz is legit.

### The guarantee

Guaranteed. If we take it on, we get it done. Payment and refund terms are agreed with you before we start. See payment and refunds.

### Where we work

Fully remote, in English, over WhatsApp or email. Clients in the USA, the UK, the UAE, Canada, Australia, Europe and the Middle East.

### Contact

- WhatsApp: +1 934 201 2490
 - Email: team@unbanz.com
 - Instagram and X: @unbanzhq

## How Unbanz works

Source: https://unbanz.com/how-it-works/

Send the username and a screenshot of the notice. Get your price. Say go and we get it done. That’s it.

### 1. Send the details

Message us on WhatsApp or email team@unbanz.com. Send the @username or profile link, a screenshot of the notice and when it happened. For a ban request, send the profile link and what it’s doing. For a username, send the name you want. For an ad account, add the account ID.

### 2. Get your price

We tell you if it’s doable and what it costs. Scope, price, payment terms, timing and any refund terms are agreed in the chat before we start. Asking doesn’t book anything.

### 3. Say go

We get to work and keep you posted on WhatsApp or email. The usual estimate is 3–14 days from the day we start.

### 4. Done

Account back, account down or username yours. Guaranteed. If we take it on, we get it done.

### Your password stays with you

We work from the username and the notice, so your password and login codes stay private. More on why Unbanz is safe.

This page sits alongside our terms. For recovery you must own the account or be authorised to act for its owner.

## Your options, compared

Source: https://unbanz.com/compare/

Account banned or disabled? You’ve got three routes: appeal in the app yourself, use Meta Verified support if you’re eligible, or have Unbanz handle it for you. Here’s how they stack up.

### At a glance

In-app appealMeta Verified supportUnbanzWho does the workYouYou, with Meta’s support chatWe doCostFreeMonthly Meta subscriptionPrice agreed before we startPlatformsInstagram, FacebookEligible Instagram and Facebook profilesInstagram, Facebook, Snapchat, Meta ad accountsBans and username claimsNoNoYesGuaranteeNoNoGuaranteed. If we take it on, we get it done.

### The in-app appeal

Free and the first thing to try. Log in, follow the on-screen steps and submit once. Great when the notice gives you a clear button and a window to use it.

### Meta Verified

A paid Meta subscription for eligible profiles that includes access to account support. Handy if you already have it and can still log in.

### Unbanz

Done for you. Send the username and the notice, get your price, say go. Covers unbans, bans and username claims on Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat, plus Meta ad accounts. Usually 3–14 days from the day we start. How it works.

### Which one should I pick?

Try the in-app appeal first if you have one. If it’s gone, didn’t work or you’d rather not spend the time, message us and we’ll tell you if it’s doable and what it costs.
